messages:
Maya CSM: Morning team — starting the Welcome/Orientation roadmap for Harbor Health (account: harbor-health). Objective: 30d activation with integrated API calls, enablement for 3 product owners, and a clean handover to Success Ops. Primary renewal risk: procurement timeline (contracts) — flagged medium. Can folks confirm availability for an initial technical sync this week?

Leon S: I can do Thu 10–11am PT. I'll own the tech kickoff and integration checklist. Need staging creds from Harbor devs.

Tori (Enablement): I'll prep a two-part enablement playbook (admin + end-user). Draft ETA: Tue EOD. Will spin up a short RSVP form for training.

Devon PM: I'll handle stakeholder comms and invite Harbor PMs + procurement. I'll also create the success criteria doc (OKRs + acceptance tests).

Sam M (MLE): I'll map expected endpoints and produce perf targets (p50/p95) and a recommended quantization profile. Please share sample payloads.

Jordan CE: I'll run our health-check and attach logging hooks. Can we point staging at: https://staging.harbor.redwood.internal/api/v1/infer — credentials pending.

sched-bot: Poll created — Thu 10am or Fri 9am? Vote here: https://cal.link/polls/abcdef

Maya CSM: Great. Preliminary timeline: Week 0 — tech sync + staging integration; Week 1 — enablement material + small pilot; Weeks 2–3 — pilot ramp, observability and cost tuning; Week 4 — success review and go/no-go. Flagging procurement leads for renewal cue at month 11.

Leon S: Noted. I'll add an integration checklist to the shared doc: https://redwood.app/docs/harbor-integration (perm: customer-success + eng). Staging config snippet: 

```
REDWOOD_ENV=staging
MODEL=redwood-ssd-1
API_KEY=<use-vault-secret>
TIMEOUT=120s
```

Tori (Enablement): I'll include a 1-hour recorded session + slides and a one-pager for Ops. Recommended audience: PM, SRE, Ops.

Devon PM: Action items updated on the board. Tagging Jordan CE for logging access.

Jordan CE: I'll need an IAM role from Harbor — Devon can you confirm by EOD?

Maya CSM: Closing loop on owners: Leon (tech), Tori (enablement), Devon (comms), Sam (MLE), Jordan (logging). I'll run weekly 30-min check-ins on Wednesdays. Anything else?

Devon PM: Confirmed. I'll update CRM: renewal risk = medium, blocker = contract timeline.

Leon S: :thumbsup:

Tori (Enablement): :raised_hands:

Maya CSM: Thanks everyone — I'll add notes to the customer-success repo and share the calendar invite. /cc @legal for contract alignment.
